title: Nice but silicone separates from the plastic after 3 months of use
text:
Nice but silicone separates from the plastic after 3 months of use. UPDATE: After 3 months of f regular use, both trays now leak. The silicone is slipping off the plastic. I just tossed them out for a run of the mill Rubbermaid product. But I have a small mess in my freezer now.
Easy to use and ideal for my RV. The lid is great for protecting the freezer while roaming around. I've used them for 4 months now and one of the cups has started to leak. However, if you've ever looked for smaller trays for your RV fridge, you will understand why I don't care as much about a minor malfunction. I'm ordering another set.

product_metadata.title: Ice Cube Trays 3 Pack, Silicone Easy-Release and Flexible 14-Ice Trays with Spill-Resistant Removable Lid, BPA Free, Durable and Dishwasher Safe
features: Food-grade safety Material -- Made of silicone and PP material, 100% BPA Free high quality materials safe and durable . Recommend boil the ice cube trays for 30mins or a few hour when first use, then use pure water to fill ice trays and frozen.

Suitable for Bar/ Home -- The ice cube is necessary in bar to cool cocktails, whiskey, tequila, vodka. And it is a useful tool at home for other homemade beverage or various ice snack like froze soup, ice cream or flower ice cube.Perfect for making ice cubes orfilling the trays with juice, fruit, jelly, chocolate, herbs, sauces and pudding and baby food purees.

Easy to Clean/Store -- Ice cube trays with removable lids can stack in freezer neatly and block odor as well as dust. Rinse off it by hand or using dishwasher. Air dry and stack them in the dry place.

Easy ice removal -- TPE material shapes the bottom well, which makes it easy to release ice cubes. Each flat cube compartment is separate from others so you can easily push from the bottom. No need for awkward bending or twisting and no more ice cubes slithering across your counter or Floor!

Make Enough Ice Cube -- The 3 pack ice cube trays of total 42 ice cubes meet your need of many ice cubes at party or restaurant. With removable lids, the ice trays are able to save room in freezer by stacking together.
description: FEATURES:
Safety:BPA free and food grade.High quality trays won’t crack while freezing.
Convenience: a simple push at the soft bottom make the ice cube pop out.
Multipurpose: Perfect for making ice cubes or filling the trays with juice, fruit, jelly,chocolate,herbs,sauces and pudding.
Spill-Resistance:Removable lids prevent leaking in the freezer.
Durability: with right use,the ice trays are reusable in each summer.
Kindly Tips:
1.Do not use metal brush to clean these ice cube trays.
2.Do not clean the ice trays with strong detergent incase they get corroded.
3.Keep these ice cube trays away from fire sources incase they get distorted.
4. After freezing,do not bend,twist or knock the ice tray.
How to Use:
1.Clean it with hot water to remove odor before first use
2.Fill the ice trays with water about 80 % and close the lid.
3.Place it for 5minutes or splash some water to let the ice melt a little.
4.Push the bottom of the tray to remove the ice cubes.
5.After rinsing off,clean the ice trays and air dry.
How to Get Ice Out Easily:
1.After taking the ice tray out of there refrigerator,don't rush to take out the ice cube,first pour the water over it for a while or soak for a while.
2.Open the ice tray lid and press the silicone section of the ice tray to remove the ice.
Specifications:

Size of each ice cube: 1.5x1.2x0.8inches
Color:White and green or white and blue

3 × Ice Cube Trays
